title: Schedule Downloader
question: Three phone-first layouts in The Lobby's existing Local Co-op design. Team builder is the recommendation. These are design proposals, not working calendar connections. Pick a layout or describe a correction; approval confirms the design only.

options.label: Team builder
options.thesis: Find teams, check their games, then choose how to put them in your calendar.
options.viewport: A compact title leads straight to team search, followed by selected teams and their games; calendar instructions follow in the same page.
options.risk: A large selection makes the page long; summary counts and a jump to calendar setup must stay useful.

options.label: One section at a time
options.thesis: Keep completed choices in short summaries while the next part of the task opens below.
options.viewport: Teams and games appear as editable summaries above the expanded calendar setup section, with Google selected and the computer requirement visible.
options.risk: Hidden details make reviewing and changing a selection slower than on the open page.

options.label: Combined agenda
options.thesis: Bring games from all chosen teams together in date order before calendar setup.
options.viewport: A compact team finder sits above a chronological schedule; each game names its team, and Outlook setup follows the agenda.
options.risk: A familiar team is less easy to inspect when its games are interleaved with another team's.
